story: NFR Workspace: the one place for AI in non-financial risk
proposition: NFR Workspace: one role-based experience, powered by reusable NFR methods, governed execution, a connected NFR core and approved integrations
anchorJourney: Third-party risk, shown in the live product

screens.title: The future of NFR, coordinated.
screens.subtitle: One Workspace coordinates your people, systems and AI where it matters: AI prepares the work, your people decide, every step on record.
screens.question: What will this conversation show me?

screens.title: Every NFR question cuts across roles, systems and teams.
screens.subtitle: Four everyday questions, five levels each: who asks, what, where the data lives, who helps, and how.
screens.closingLine: Every NFR question cuts across roles, systems and teams, so the real work happens between them.
screens.question: What does the risk function keep being asked?

screens.title: Standalone AI sees one system. NFR needs the whole picture.
screens.subtitle: Red marks what no assistant sees. The full answer needs all eight systems.
screens.closingLine: Each assistant sees one system, but the answer needs all eight, so people still join them by hand.
screens.question: Do we not have AI already?

screens.title: A supplier changes. Your records do not.
screens.subtitle: Novalink moves its hosting to a subcontractor. Every record still says green until an outage, 110 days later.
screens.closingLine: A supplier change leaves every record green; the notice was there on day 12, but nothing joined it.
screens.question: Why does one change matter?

screens.title: From question to answer: how the information flows.
screens.subtitle: Pick a role, then a depth: Light shows the screen, Medium the sources, Deep how each button runs.
screens.closingLine: Each button has one defined route: it reads within the person's access and writes only once approved.
screens.question: How does the information flow to the answer, and how deep do we go?

screens.title: Four ways of working, each run by its own agent.
screens.subtitle: From finding facts to weighing trade-offs: the more judgement, the closer the person, and every answer shows why.
screens.closingLine: Each way has its own agent and its own proof; the more judgement, the closer the person.
screens.question: What is NFR Workspace, and why can we trust each answer?

screens.title: From AI pilots to a Workspace that grows by module.
screens.subtitle: Set up once in six months with one team, then add the next group on the same core.
screens.closingLine: Set up the core once with one team, then add teams one at a time on what is already proven.
screens.question: How does it start, and how does it grow?

screens.title: One profile per person: their screen, data and actions.
screens.subtitle: Built from your identity system in six levels, from role down to a single field. Same role, different scope, different screen.
screens.closingLine: Your identity system sets each profile; the Workspace turns it into their screen, data and actions.
screens.question: How is each profile set up, and what does each person see?

screens.title: Every step secured. Every person sees only their part.
screens.subtitle: One request end to end: who asks, what is read, where it runs, what is kept, and what each role sees.
screens.closingLine: Security follows the person through every step, and each role sees only the fields it may.
screens.question: How is the data kept safe, and who sees what?

screens.title: Enter NFR Workspace.
screens.subtitle: The real product on synthetic records: one role, one working day, one complete process, from case to recorded decision.
screens.closingLine: What follows is the live product on synthetic data: the proof behind every screen so far.
screens.question: What does the working day look like?

screens.title: The five acts, captured from the product.
screens.subtitle: The same synthetic records and screens as the live Workspace. Space steps through; at the end, the story continues.
screens.closingLine: Captured from the live product: same data, same labels, same screens.
screens.question: What if the live product is unavailable?
screens.evidenceLabel: CAPTURED FROM NFR WORKSPACE · SYNTHETIC DATA
